Для решения этой части задания следует у: To solve this part of the task, several important points should be taken into account. First, since the processes occur without heat exchange and without work being done, the gas in vessel {#0} is a closed system. Therefore, its internal energy is conserved. Second, if some amount of heat is released during the combination of molecules (recombination), the same amount of heat must be absorbed in the reverse reaction, i.e., during the decay of a triatomic molecule. And since the number of decays is greater than the number of combinations, overall, chemical reactions result in heat absorption. In other words, part of the internal energy of the gas (i.e., the kinetic energy of the thermal motion of molecules) is converted into chemical bond energy. Another explanation: two atoms bound into one molecule have negative atomic bond energy. Therefore, energy is required to break the molecule apart.
